scope: One scoped review of the stable first-power change, generation driver output selection and serial benchmark; no findings require another review cycle.

checks.exactness: x^1 is the imported original exact scalar; exponent!=1 retains the original binary exponentiation.
checks.authority: Public importing delegates to embedded, admits source depth and rejects foreign lineage before returning an owned value.
checks.cancellation: scalarQuery retains ExactRootAccess entry/body/terminal admission; public callers retain their existing terminal checkpoints.
checks.resources: Only unperformed integer/unit multiplication work and allocations disappear; caller limits and current exact-boundary failure fixture remain unchanged.
checks.ownership: Immutable field/context/storage/calculation owners are retained. No shared mutable state, new unsafe boundary, conditional Sendable or platform-specific storage is introduced.
checks.benchmark: Unchanged actual fixture and compiler configuration; three alternating process pairs; hash admission outside wall/CPU timing; historical source overrides match committed hashes; every emitted artifact and log remains byte-bound.
checks.runner: Optional fresh output directory preserves the default and overwrite refusal. Package inspection lanes retry serially after a diagnosed pre-compilation lock-message parse failure.
